sources.summary: Organised by University College Dublin and AMPS this conference explores how towns, cities and regions can respond to climate change, social challenges and urban transformation. Bringing together architecture, planning, sustainability, conservation, public health and community perspectives it is explicitly interdisciplinary. Dublin itself provides a compelling setting for the event, combining historic neighbourhoods, Georgian architecture, modernist housing, docklands regeneration, expanding transport, diverse cultural history and sometimes contentious community issues. Publications by UCL Press & Cambridge Scholars Publishing. Conference Type: In-person & Virtual (Pre-recorded and written paper submissions accepted) Abstract Submission deadline: December 5, 2026 (Round One) | April 10, 2027 (Round Two) Conference URL
